description: Read a known job's status, errors, elapsed time and content references. Article jobs include kit_status, kit_revision, kit_confidence and review_reasons. An awaiting_review job with kit_status=needs_review is held for kit review. Other awaiting_review jobs await editorial review. Completed, completed_with_errors, failed and cancelled are terminal statuses. A job ID alone does not establish that a draft was saved. After a failed article write, the kit's current write_state identifies whether a write is still owed for that generation. The minimum polling interval is 30 seconds, subject to a longer Retry-After.
name: get_job

anyOf.description:
Job poll result. ``content_item_id`` populates once the run targets or
creates an item. Reads persisted job state only (no live backend sync on
read). Failed jobs may include ``error`` and machine-readable ``error_type``.

One finding that held a saved draft for review.

status.description:
Status of a background job.

Terminal states: ``completed``, ``completed_with_errors``, ``failed``,
``cancelled``. Active (in-progress) states: ``queued``, ``running``.

``awaiting_review`` is a third class: not terminal (work may resume after a
human action) and not active (no automatic progress is being made). Pollers
should treat it as stop-and-review rather than keep waiting for a terminal
status. It is intentionally in neither ``is_terminal`` nor ``is_active``.
